name: computer_scroll
description: Scroll at pixel coordinates (x, y) of the most recent computer_observe result. One step equals a single mouse wheel notch. Observe again afterwards: the page may have moved by a different amount than you expect.

x.description: Pixels from the left edge of the last observation.

y.description: Pixels from the top edge of the last observation.

steps.description: Wheel notches; 1 step is one notch.
